text:
tara: deploy-bot flagged a release-notes -> binary mismatch for release v5.0.0. Notes reference `--fast-path` but the binary exits on unknown flag.

deploy-bot: Rule RN-082 triggered: release_notes_binary_mismatch. Recommended: pause rollout, rollback to v4.9.8, or cut hotfix v5.0.1.

ops-ian: Any customer errors?

tara: No external alerts. QA saw startup error: `Unhandled flag: fast-path`.

nate: Hotfix keeps telemetry tidy. Rollback is faster but will fragment metrics and experiments.

ops-ian: Operational times: rollback ~12m, hotfix ~45m. Auto-rollback thresholds not met (p95 +3%). No immediate abort.

support-sam: I'll prep a one-line CSM note: "Paused rollout; hotfix in progress; no impact observed."

tara: Plan: pause rollout, pin traffic to v4.9.8, hotpatch v5.0.1 with flag handler, smoke, then staged promote.

ops-ian: Running: `deployctl pause --release v5.0.0` 1: paused. `deployctl traffic pin --to v4.9.8 --percent 100` 1: pinned.

tara: Hotpatch branch created. Staging build ok. Merged and tagged v5.0.1. Kicking staged rollout at 2%.

deploy-bot: v5.0.1 detected. Staged rollout healthy -> ramping.

nate: Monitoring dashboards. No anomalies.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete; v5.0.1 at 100%. No regressions in 20m window. Marking stable.

tara: Filing RN-083 to gate changelog edits that introduce flags. Closing thread.
